summary: The article argues that sports have long prioritized physical training while neglecting athletes' mental health, and that mindfulness and mental health programs are an overdue remedy. It cites prevalence data, high-profile athletes speaking out, gaps in current support, research on mindfulness benefits, and early adopters like the Sunville Suns. It also covers obstacles (limited resources, scarce sports psychologists, cultural resistance) and calls for athlete-led advocacy and holistic training.
one_line: Sports organizations are beginning to adopt mindfulness and mental health training for athletes, but resource shortages and stigma still limit mainstream adoption.
key_facts: A Journal of Sports Psychology study published September 5, 2023 found approximately 35% of elite athletes suffer from stress, anxiety, or depression at any given point in their careers.
Swimming champion Michael Andrews said in a September 2023 interview that performance anxiety almost derailed his career during the peak years of his swimming tenure.
Basketball player Jordan Sinclair has campaigned for greater openness and acceptance of mental health challenges since her public revelation on October 12, 2023.
Many sporting bodies lack specialized staff, financial resources, or comprehensive training in the psychological aspects of the athlete experience.
Generic counseling services may not address the specific stressors of competitive sports or give athletes strategies to use in the heat of competition.
A research study published September 28, 2023 found athletes who practiced mindfulness had lower stress levels and improved concentration compared to those who did not.
Sports psychologist Dr. Elena Richardson argues mindfulness can aid injury recovery by helping athletes handle the frustration and altered physicality of recovery.
The Sunville Suns basketball team began holding mindfulness sessions before every practice as of September 2023.
Coach Terrence Jackson credits the Sunville Suns' mindfulness sessions with improving team cohesion and game-time composure and a noticeable uptick in performance.
Gymnast Ellie Harmon spoke on November 3, 2023 about how mindfulness helped her maintain composure during competitions.
Obstacles to mainstreaming mindfulness include limited resources, overstretched athletic itineraries, a shortage of sports psychology professionals, and cultural resistance valuing toughness.
The article argues athlete-led advocacy can create demand for mental health resources and push institutions to allocate attention and funds.
